senses.gloss: to formally leave a job or position

definition_translations.ja_JP: 仕事や役職を正式に辞める

senses.gloss: to accept an unpleasant situation because it cannot be changed
senses.example: The team resigned itself to a longer approval process.

translations.th_TH: จำใจยอมรับ

example_translations.zh_TW: 團隊只好接受審批流程會更久的現實。

example_translations.ko_KR: 팀은 승인 절차가 더 길어지는 상황을 받아들일 수밖에 없었습니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Nhóm đành chấp nhận quy trình phê duyệt kéo dài hơn.
example_translations.th_TH: ทีมจำใจยอมรับว่ากระบวนการอนุมัติจะใช้เวลานานขึ้น
